activities.caption: file each statement through the right lens
activities.name: sraEmicSort

config.prompt: Emic (insider's lens) or etic (analyst's lens) — file each statement:

items.label: fasting disciplines bodies and synchronises calendars
the ritual bonds the group and transmits memory
the icon is a window into heaven
the icon concentrates attention and anchors institutions

config.why: Both are data — and confusing them is the field's original sin in both directions: taking the insider's account as explanation abandons scholarship; treating the analyst's account as better truth commits a category error. A good study needs both.

activities.caption: true or false — what agnosticism is
activities.name: sraAgnosticJudge

statements.s: Methodological agnosticism means the scholar believes nothing.
statements.why: It means suspending one particular question — is it true? — to pursue others: what does it do? how did it develop? who benefits?

statements.s: The enterprise is 'objective' in the sense of being without values.
statements.why: The choice of questions is itself a value-laden act — which is why the field keeps auditing its own history.

statements.s: The scholar neither affirms nor denies the tradition's truth-claims.
statements.why: Ninian Smart's term — not because the claims don't matter, but because they are not the scholar's questions.

statements.s: A scholar who writes 'the rite works because the deity commands it' has joined the tradition.
statements.why: Taking the insider's account as explanation abandons scholarship — that sentence is theology's job.

activities.anchor: Each social-scientific method sees a different layer
activities.caption: pair each discipline with its reading
activities.name: sraMethodsMatch

config.prompt: The shelf of instruments — pair each with what it reads:

pairs.right: maps the shape of traditions — Smart's seven dimensions as its standard instrument
Durkheim's 'society worshipping itself'; Weber's Protestant Ethic
Geertz's thick description — a blink is a twitch, a wink is a signal
'the opium of the people' — and 'the sigh of the oppressed creature'

config.why: History reads development too — philology, textual criticism, archaeology: the tools that date documents, trace borrowings and catch retrojections. No method owns the object, because there is no single object.

activities.anchor: so the dimensions are read together
activities.caption: find the faulty line — the dimensions audited
activities.name: sraDimensionsSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary of Smart's framework is wrong — click it:
lines: The seven dimensions: ritual, narrative/mythic, experiential/emotional, social/institutional, ethical/legal, doctrinal/philosophical, material.
Studying any one dimension alone distorts the rest.
The framework is a taxonomy — its job is filing traditions into types.
Doctrine alone makes Buddhism a philosophy; ritual alone makes it gymnastics.
Each tradition is described with all seven at once — holism is the point.
config.correction: The framework is a lens for holistic description, not a taxonomy — the dimensions describe traditions from the inside; they do not grade them.
config.why: Which is exactly what the misconception gets backwards: the dimensions are read together for each tradition, never used to file traditions into boxes.

config.text: Tylor's substantive minimum defines religion as '%%0%%'; Tillich's functional definition as 'whatever is a person's %%1%%'. The sharpest modern finding: the category itself is %%2%% — forged in Europe and exported by colonial administration.
config.hint: One names a content, one names a role, and the third names when the category was built.

activities.anchor: The discipline's history is a sequence of corrections
activities.caption: scrub the field's corrections
activities.name: sraFieldTimeline

events.title: Müller's Sacred Books of the East
events.text: 1879–1910, 50 volumes of translated primary texts into every serious library — comparative philology's 'science of religion'.

events.title: James's Varieties
events.text: Mystics' and converts' reports treated as data — experience judged pragmatically, by its fruits.

events.title: Durkheim's Elementary Forms
events.text: The sacred/profane split — and the thesis that in worship society is worshipping itself.

events.title: Otto's Idea of the Holy
events.text: The numinous, the mysterium tremendum — the phenomenological turn from origins to essence.

events.title: The critical era
events.text: 1970s onward: the category itself historicised (Asad, Cantwell Smith, Nongbri) and the field's own politics exposed.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — James audited
activities.name: sraJamesSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary of James's method is wrong — click it:
lines: The Varieties of Religious Experience (1902) is still the entry point for the psychology of religion.
James studied reports of mystics and converts as data.
The recurring marks he extracted: ineffability, noetic quality, transiency, passivity.
He graded the experiences against the creeds that produced them.
The question 'is it true?' was replaced by 'what does it do to the life that has it?'
config.correction: He judged the experiences pragmatically — by their fruits, what they do to the life that has them.
config.why: The emic/etic discipline performed, decades before the vocabulary existed — reports treated as data, not verdicts.

config.prompt: The two symmetrical hazards of comparison — drag the divider:

before.label: Flattening
before.text: The comparative table that files the Eucharist, prasad and kaddish in one row called 'sacred food' — categories gain order and lose truth: what each means to its practitioners is erased.

after.label: Fetishising uniqueness
after.text: 'Each tradition is sui generis, beyond comparison' — learning from one another becomes impossible, and the tradition being protected is quietly elevated.

config.why: The working middle: compare dimensions (Smart's framework), hold labels loosely, let insiders check the descriptions — and remember traditions borrow constantly: the Pure Land and the Virgin Mary are histories of contact.

activities.anchor: One dimension, four economies, four theologies
activities.caption: pair each journey with its detail
activities.name: sraJourneysMatch

config.prompt: Sacred journeys, compared — pair each with what distinguishes it:

pairs.right: an obligation for those able — its rites re-enacting Hagar's search for water
mass bathing, timed by planetary astrology — crowds among the largest human gatherings
medieval penance turned post-religious walking tourism
dying near the Ganges for liberation

config.why: The comparison earns its keep on the constants — distance sanctifies, because the journey's cost is part of the meaning; the insider accounts keep it honest about the differences. Which is, in miniature, the whole method.
